sentence: This project builds tools to map metal ions and metabolites in cells and tissues, and designs models of metalloenzymes involved in oxygen and nitrogen metabolism.
This project tests whether a particular loss can predict how patients with prostate cancer respond to treatment with an inhibitor.
This project studies how the peripheral nervous system, which connects the brain to all organs, might set the tempo of aging.
This project works with primary care providers and patients to find ways to carry out breast cancer screening using clinical breast examination.
This project tries to find out how the oral pathogen Prevotella intermedia helps oral squamous cell carcinoma progress.
This project builds software and analysis methods that help researchers make sense of large cancer data sets.
This project provides a robotic system that automates laboratory protocols and procedures to make them more precise and repeatable.
This project studies how human leukocyte antigen gene variations affect immune response to treatment in patients with non-small cell lung cancer.
This project develops improved compounds that break down the Tat protein of HIV and tests them in animal models of HIV infection.
This project studies how the circadian clock creates rhythms in metabolism that support health and fitness.
This project tries to find out how endosomal membranes are damaged and repaired and how this relates to delivery of cargo into the cytosol.
This project provides equipment and expertise in transgenic technology and genome engineering for making genetically engineered mouse models.
This project uses computational and experimental approaches to identify and target neomorphic drivers in glioma, sarcoma, and endometrial cancers.
This project studies polyamine metabolism as a vulnerability of leukemia stem cells in acute myeloid leukemia.
This project builds an artificial intelligence assistant that supports hospital care for substance use disorders, from early identification to starting treatment.
This project tests whether instantaneous digital subtraction angiography can give enough contrast for intravenous angiography without motion artifacts.
This project tries to find out which antigens certain T-immune cells target in type 1 diabetes.
This project maps how Nodal signaling and T-Box transcription factors shape cell types during somitic mesoderm development in zebrafish.
This project builds delivery and targeting methods that control immune responses so gene therapy with adeno-associated viruses can be given more than once.
This project explores a therapeutic target in rhabdomyosarcoma to understand how the cancer depends on splicing.
